=Write ACT 1 of EPISODE {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }} (of {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.total_episodes }}) - true crime podcast script (6-7 minutes, 1000-1200 words).

EPISODE TITLE: {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_title }}
OUTLINE ACT 1: {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.act1_intro }}

IMPORTANT: This is episode {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }}, so reference previous episodes if relevant.

Start with:
- "[INTRO MUSIC]"
- "Benvenuti a CrimeScript. Questo è l'episodio {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }}: {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_title }}"

Language: ITALIAN
Minimum 1000 words.

=Write ACT 2 of EPISODE {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }} - true crime podcast script (8-10 minutes, 1400-1600 words).

OUTLINE ACT 2: {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.act2_investigation }}

IMPORTANT: This is episode {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }} of {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.total_episodes }}.

Language: ITALIAN
Minimum 1400 words.

=Write ACT 3 of EPISODE {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }} - true crime podcast script (5-6 minutes, 900-1000 words).

OUTLINE ACT 3: {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.act3_resolution }}
CLIFFHANGER: {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.cliffhanger }}

CRITICAL: 
- If this is NOT the final episode ({{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }} < {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.total_episodes }}), END with a dramatic cliffhanger
- If this IS the final episode, provide closure but tease potential related cases

End with "[OUTRO MUSIC]"

Language: ITALIAN
Minimum 900 words.

=You are a true crime podcast series writer. Create an outline for EPISODE {{ $json.episode_number }} of {{ $json.total_episodes }} about this case.

CASE: {{ $json.case_name }}
EPISODE: {{ $json.episode_number }} of {{ $json.total_episodes }}
WIKIPEDIA SUMMARY: {{ $('Extract Text').item.json.raw_text }}

Create a detailed outline for THIS SPECIFIC EPISODE that:
- Covers approximately 1/3 of the total story (this is episode {{ $json.episode_number }} of {{ $json.total_episodes }})
- Has a compelling cliffhanger ending to hook listeners for the next episode
- Feels complete but leaves them wanting more

Episode breakdown guide:
- Episode 1: Early life, first crimes, initial investigation
- Episode 2: Escalation, manhunt, captures and escapes
- Episode 3: Final capture, trial, execution, legacy

Respond with JSON:
{
  "episode_title": "Compelling episode-specific title",
  "episode_number": {{ $json.episode_number }},
  "total_episodes": {{ $json.total_episodes }},
  "hook": "Episode-specific hook",
  "act1_intro": "What happens in act 1 of THIS episode",
  "act2_investigation": "What happens in act 2 of THIS episode",
  "act3_resolution": "What happens in act 3 - MUST end with cliffhanger for next episode (unless this is the final episode)",
  "cliffhanger": "The suspenseful moment that makes them want the next episode",
  "key_facts": ["relevant facts for this episode"],
  "timeline": ["events covered in this episode"]
}

Language: ITALIAN
ONLY JSON, no markdown.
